set system host-name DeviceB.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set chassis fpc 0.explanation: Sets the specified parameter for a Flexible PIC Concentrator (FPC) in the Junos chassis, configuring hardware-specific behavior or operational state.

pic 0.explanation: This command configures a Flexible PIC Concentrator (FPC) and its associated Physical Interface Card (PIC) in a Junos device, specifying parameters for hardware settings.

clocking line.explanation: The command `clocking [parameter3]` configures the clocking mode or source for a specific interface or module in Junos, ensuring proper synchronization.
